issues.issue: The General Fund budget schedule's Actual column prints 'Transfers out 58,742' with no parentheses. The page's own arithmetic uses it as positive throughout: Total other financing sources & uses 8,283,419 = 8,158,225 + 58,742 + 64,952 + 1,500; net change (134,742) = (8,418,161) + 8,283,419; variance 117,484 = 58,742 - (-58,742). The extractor reversed the sign (citing the fund statement p6, which prints (58,742)), so the lines no longer tie to the printed total 8,283,419. The page does add up as printed, so report_discrepancies[4] ('lines total 8,165,935') describes the extractor's change, not a fault in the report. As printed means +58,742, with a note that it disagrees with p6.
issues.resolved: schema: detail other-financing transfers are signed (Transfers out negative); the printed total adds transfers out as positive, so the 117,484 gap stays in report_discrepancies
